DifferentialShift.name: DifferentialShift
DifferentialShift.description: Represents a collection of fields to store the information about shifts different from the normal shifts of a resource. These shifts are marked against the timesheet entries.

Name.description: The name of the differential shift.

External ID.description: The external ID associated with the differential shift.

Id.description: The record ID of the differential shift.

Description.description: The description of the differential shift.

IsActive.description: Indicates whether the differential shift is active (true) or not (false).

EffectiveStartDate.description: Specifies the date when the differential shift starts.

EffectiveEndDate.description: Specifies the date when the differential shift ends.
